title: Understanding the pH scale in tenfold steps
quote: pH is reported in "logarithmic units". Each number represents a 10-fold change in the acidity/basicness of the water.

rungs.label: Neutral water at pH 7
rungs.quote: The range goes from 0 to 14, with 7 being neutral.

rungs.label: Normal rainfall at pH 5.6
rungs.quote: Normal rainfall has a pH of about 5.6—slightly acidic due to carbon dioxide gas from the atmosphere.

rungs.label: Mine drainage at pH 2
rungs.quote: water coming out of an abandoned coal mine can have a pH of 2, which is very acidic

rungs.label: Water at pH 5
rungs.quote: Water with a pH of five is ten times more acidic than water having a pH of six.

rungs.label: Water at pH 6
rungs.quote: water having a pH of six.
